findings: Both per-core five-panel figures preserve matched tissue orientation, anatomy, crop and source blue region boundaries across histology, h4, h0, PCA and scVI.
The combined two-by-five panel and all-representation two-by-seven panel have correct core/method labels, visible 500 micrometre scale bars and no material clipping or title/legend overlap.
Resolution panels show all four prespecified resolutions, both seeds, correct transfer source/target labels, full zero-to-one score axes and the all-positive baseline; the method legend is readable.

Oracle error maps visibly distinguish green overlap, red outside-outline spill, blue missed annotated footprint and gray true negatives. Titles identify the oracle as descriptive rather than unbiased accuracy.
Independent method colors are stated on the comparison panels; cluster-to-color lookup is retained in figures/cluster_color_keys.csv.
Some wide white margins remain, but they do not obscure tissue or labels and are not a blocking presentation issue.
scientific_presentation_limits: Registration is approximate section correspondence, with a visible internal coverage difference in core 23; reviewed figures do not establish pixel-exact histology.
Scores are annotation agreement on the segmented-cell footprint; white intercellular/background pixels and complete-region coverage are handled separately in the report.
The inspected plots retain unfavorable comparisons and seed variation; no universal h4 superiority or cancer-free status outside outlines is implied.
